heroHeadline: MBS Joins Trump's Muslim-Leader Call; Record Q1 Deficit; Aramco Launches Quantum Computer
heroSubtitle: Saudi Arabia recorded its largest quarterly budget deficit since 2018 — SAR 125.7B ($33.5B) — as Iran war military spending surged 26% and Hormuz-disrupted oil revenues collapsed. MBS joined a Trump-convened multilateral call with leaders from eight Muslim-majority nations on May 24 to discuss regional security and Iran. Aramco launched Saudi Arabia's first quantum computer with French firm Pasqal on May 18, while the IMF downgraded Saudi 2026 growth by 1.4pp to 3.1% and the PIF pivoted sports investment away from LIV Golf toward football and the 2034 World Cup.
